source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 神农旧事，芳华动容
title: 神农旧事，芳华动容
purpose: 承接白衣女子询问刹那芳华曲来历：拓拔野讲述南际山顶邂逅神农、接受临终重托、坠入龙潭；白衣女子听到神农百草毒发与刹那芳华曲后动容。画面只做无声视觉，不生成口播、字幕、歌词、血书内容或可读文字。

continuity_from.source_grounding: E:\workspace\ComfyUIProjects\搜神记.txt gb18030 excerpt around 刹那芳华 / 神农百草毒发 / 龙牙岩 / 龙潭。

image_reference_policy: Use one strong reference image per storyboard workflow. SH01 anchors to previous SC11 flute-hook frame. SH02 anchors to Shennong reference. SH03 anchors to Dragon Pool reference for environment and abstract fall. SH04 anchors to Yushiqie reference for restrained emotional reaction.
video_policy: If stable reference-driven I2V is unavailable, use Comfy technical still fallback for pipeline continuity and mark outputs non-production. If true I2V is restored, use only the approved storyboard image as source of truth.

localization_policy.screen_text: Do not generate readable text, captions, subtitles, UI, signs, labels, plaques, speech bubbles, musical notes, English words, or clear Chinese inscriptions inside image/video.
localization_policy.letter_rule: Do not render readable blood letter contents, song lyrics, 神农, 空桑, 木族, 刹那芳华, or any Chinese/English text. Sealed documents may appear only folded or turned away.
localization_policy.dialogue_audio: Do not ask the video model to synthesize spoken dialogue, lip-sync, flute/xiao audio, heartbeat audio, music, or sound effects. Chinese dialogue, narration, and subtitles should be added later in editing.
production_dialogue_lines: 那曲子，是神农前辈临终时所唱。
我在南际山顶遇见他，受他所托。
后来我跌入龙潭，才有了之后这些事。
神农……百草毒发？他竟是在龙牙岩物化？
